pages.description: What setup covers and how long it takes.
pages.intro:
Welcome to Test2.

Setup takes about two minutes:

1. **Your business**: tell us your business name and who to contact.
2. **Connect Xero**: sign in to Xero so the agent can read your accounts.

Nothing in Xero is changed during setup. You can come back and edit these details at any time.
